qrp.mode.toggle.tooltip: Adds these packs on top of the ones you have on. Press again to take them off.
qrp.mode.profile.tooltip: Swaps your whole pack list for these packs. Press again to get your old list back.
qrp.mode.cycle.tooltip: Steps through these packs one at a time, in order.
qrp.welcome.title: Quick Resource Pack
qrp.welcome.subtitle: Press %s to set up a slot
qrp.wheel.title: Pack Wheel
qrp.wheel.hint_hold: Point at a slot and let go of %s. Press 1 to 9 to pick, Esc to close.
qrp.wheel.hint_click: Click a slot or press 1 to 9. Press %s or Esc to close.
qrp.packscreen.tooltip: Quick Resource Pack: slots, keys and the Pack Wheel
qrp.hub.title: Quick Resource Pack
qrp.hub.empty.title: No slots yet
qrp.hub.empty.body: Add a slot to switch packs with a key or the Pack Wheel.
qrp.edit.title: Edit Slot
qrp.edit.name: Name
qrp.edit.key.tooltip: Click, then press a key. Hold Shift, Ctrl or Alt for a combo. Esc clears it.
qrp.edit.primary.tooltip: A tap of the Quick Switch key presses this slot.
qrp.edit.wheel.tooltip: Shows this slot in the Pack Wheel.
qrp.edit.startup.tooltip: Turns this slot on when the game starts.
qrp.edit.insert.tooltip: Where these packs go in your pack list. Packs above win when two change the same thing.
qrp.edit.cycle_off.tooltip: Adds a step with none of these packs on.
qrp.edit.delete.title: Delete this slot?
qrp.edit.delete.body: '%s' and its rules will be deleted. Your packs stay where they are.
qrp.rules.title: Rules
qrp.rules.subtitle: Turn slots on by themselves on a server, in a world or in a dimension
qrp.rules.enabled.tooltip: Turn all rules on or off without deleting them.
qrp.rules.empty.title: No rules yet
qrp.rules.empty.body: A rule can turn on your PvP pack whenever you join a server.
qrp.rule.title: Edit Rule
qrp.rule.help.server: The server address. * matches anything, so *.example.net covers every subdomain.
qrp.rule.help.world: The singleplayer world name. * matches anything.
qrp.rule.help.dimension: overworld, the_nether, the_end, or a modded id like mod:dimension.
qrp.rule.use_current.none: Join a world to fill this in
qrp.options.title: Quick Resource Pack Options
qrp.options.notifications.tooltip: How a pack switch is announced. Errors always show.
qrp.options.seamless.tooltip: Packs load in the background while you play, without the loading screen.
qrp.options.wheel.tooltip: Hold the Quick Switch key to pick a slot from a wheel.
qrp.options.hold.tooltip: How long to hold the Quick Switch key before the wheel opens.
qrp.options.hud.tooltip: Shows the icons of your active slots in a corner, like status effects.
qrp.options.animations.tooltip: Turn off for an instant wheel with no motion.
